notes: EVERY REFUSAL IS NOW SPOKEN ALOUD, NOT JUST SHOWN. When the app declines to post something — the period is closed, the cheque is already used, the float would go overdrawn — it puts a red notice on the screen. Reading software could not see 106 of those 108 notices. Someone working by ear was told nothing at all, and carried on believing the entry had gone through. That is the worst way for a refusal to fail. Every one of them now announces itself, and errors interrupt where confirmations still wait their turn. THE TABLES NOW SAY WHICH HEADING BELONGS TO WHICH FIGURE. In 620 places a column or row heading was on the screen but not declared as a heading, so a figure could be read out with no idea what it was the amount OF. THE BOXES IN THE GRIDS NOW HAVE NAMES. Journal debit and credit, invoice lines, coupon batches, approval tiers, stock counts — 27 boxes announced themselves as "edit, blank". Each now says which line it belongs to: "Debit, line 2". THE KEYBOARD REACHES THE PAGE. A new "skip to main content" link means Tab no longer crosses all forty-odd menu items before arriving at the screen you are already on — every time you change screen. The menu also states which screen you are on, rather than only shading it. And the dialog boxes — confirmations, the password change, the lock screen, the search box — now take the keyboard when they open, keep it inside while they are open, and hand it back to the button you came from when they close. TWO FIGURES THAT DESCRIBED THEMSELVES WRONGLY. In the Import Wizard, discarding a file left the green "rows read, review below" message sitting over an empty screen. On the Dashboard, the number on "Needs attention" counted only the warnings while the list underneath showed warnings AND notices — a panel of five items wearing a 3. AND A NEW CHECK BEFORE EVERY RELEASE opens every single screen in the built app and fails if any of them errors, comes up blank, or throws while drawing. This app has shipped a version before where whole screens were blank while every other test passed, because the fault was in the packaging rather than the logic. That can no longer leave here unnoticed. NO DATABASE CHANGE: your data and settings are untouched and you install straight over the old version. Back up first as a habit — Backup & Export, Back up now.
